description: This file defines API routes for a FastAPI application related to energy usage data analysis. It handles CSV upload, session management, dataset processing (column selection, normalization), computation of summary metrics, anomaly detection, and timeseries data retrieval for visualization.

methods.name: str _ensure_session(response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str])
methods.description: Ensures a session exists for the current request and sets a session cookie in the response.

methods.name: SessionInfo get_session(response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None))
methods.description: Returns session info for the current browser session.

methods.name: DatasetStatusResponse get_dataset_status(response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None))
methods.description: Returns whether the current session has dataset payload and a small preview.

methods.name: CsvUploadPreviewResponse upload_dataset_csv( response: Response, file: UploadFile = File(..., description="CSV file containing electricity/energy usage data."), vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None), )
methods.description: Handles CSV upload, parsing, cleaning, and stores a preview in session.

methods.name: DatasetSelectColumnsResponse select_dataset_columns_and_normalize( request: DatasetSelectColumnsRequest, response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None), )
methods.description: Processes user-selected columns and normalizes energy usage to kWh, storing processed data.

methods.name: list[dict] _get_processed_rows_or_400(session_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves processed dataset rows from session or raises an error if not available.

methods.name: SummaryMetricsResponse get_summary_metrics( response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None), region: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional exact-match region filter."), )
methods.description: Computes summary metrics (average, max, total kWh) over processed dataset, optionally filtered by region.

methods.name: AnomalyDetectionResponse get_anomalies( response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None), region: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional exact-match region filter."), threshold_ratio: float = Query( default=0.20, ge=0.0, le=10.0, description="Anomaly threshold ratio above baseline average (0.20 = 20%).", ), )
methods.description: Detects anomalies where energy usage exceeds baseline average by a specified ratio.

methods.name: TimeseriesResponse get_timeseries( response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None), region: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional exact-match region filter."), include_anomalies: bool = Query(default=True, description="Whether to include a second dataset containing only anomalies."), anomaly_threshold_ratio: float = Query( default=0.20, ge=0.0, le=10.0, description="Threshold ratio used to compute anomaly series (0.20 = 20%).", ), )
methods.description: Provides Chart.js formatted energy usage timeseries with optional anomalies included.

ctags.signature: ( response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None), region: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional exact-match region filter."), threshold_ratio: float = Query( default=0.20, ge=0.0, le=10.0, description="Anomaly threshold ratio above baseline average (0.20 = 20%).", ), )

ctags.pattern: /^def get_session(response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None)) -> Sess/

ctags.signature: ( response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None), region: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional exact-match region filter."), )
